start.title: NAHX Technologies – Understand Technology. Create Solutions.
start.description: Technical documentation, software development and automation: NAHX Technologies combines technical expertise with digital development to build clear solutions.
start.einleitung: I combine technical expertise with digital development. From technical documentation to custom software and intelligent automation, I work on solutions that address real requirements and improve workflows.

karten.text: I help turn complex technical information into clear, structured and traceable documentation.
I design and develop digital tools that simplify specific tasks and address individual requirements.
I explore and implement practical ways to streamline repetitive processes and support technical workflows.

abschnitte.text: Good solutions start with understanding the problem. My approach focuses on requirements, practical value and a transparent implementation process.

schritte.text: Use feedback to refine the result.

karten.text: Development and improvement of digital tools that support the review of technical documentation. Project roles, product rights and collaboration with FSH Documentation are clearly defined.
Design and implementation of custom applications for specific workflows and organizational needs.
Technical implementation, structuring and ongoing improvement of websites and digital platforms.

leistungen.einleitung: I work at the intersection of technical documentation, software and digital processes. Depending on the requirements, the right solution may be a documentation service, a custom application or an improved workflow.

ueber-mich.title: About | NAHX Technologies
ueber-mich.description: About NAHX Technologies: technical services, development projects and digital solutions under one personal brand. Pragmatic, project-based and transparent work.
ueber-mich.h1: Understand Technology. See the Connections. Build Solutions.
ueber-mich.einleitung: I work at the intersection of technical documentation and digital development. I care not only about whether something works technically, but also whether it is understandable, practical and suitable for integration into existing workflows.

absaetze: With NAHX Technologies, I bring together my own technical services, development projects and future digital solutions under a personal brand.
My approach is pragmatic: understand the requirements, develop an appropriate solution and validate the results transparently.
I work directly and project by project, with the goal of translating technical complexity into practical outcomes.

abschnitte.text: How a project with me works, from the first conversation to the handover.

zusammenarbeit.title: How We Work | NAHX Technologies
zusammenarbeit.description: How a project with NAHX Technologies works: initial discussion, requirements and scope, implementation in clear steps, review and handover. Direct and clear.
zusammenarbeit.einleitung: Four steps from the first conversation to the handover. The exact process depends on the scope, complexity and requirements of each project.

schritte.text: We discuss the current situation, your goals and the challenges to be addressed.
We define the services needed, the expected deliverables and the relevant constraints.
I work through the agreed scope in clear steps and keep important decisions and open issues transparent.
We evaluate the outcome against agreed criteria and coordinate the handover and any next steps.
